231:t_017:20.en:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「Hey, you! Just because you've learned a little about music doesn't mean you can butt in and say whatever you like!」

231:t_017:21.en:
$$ゲペルニッチ$$
「Whatever I like? Are you speaking to me, the self-proclaimed greatest $$熱気バサラ$$ fan in the universe?」

231:t_018:1.en:
$$シビル$$
「$$シビル$$... like $$バサラ$$'s song...」

231:t_018:3.en:
$$ゲペルニッチ$$
「$$シビル$$... You still believe in $$熱気バサラ$$'s song, even after he has fallen so low...」

231:t_018:4.en:
$$バサラ$$
「Hold on, you $$ゲペなんとか$$ bastard!」

231:t_018:5.en:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「His name is $$ゲペルニッチ$$!」

231:t_018:8.en:
$$ゲペルニッチ$$
「Then let me hear it!」

231:t_018:9.en:
$$バサラ$$
「$$シビル$$! You come, too!!」

231:t_019:0.en:
$$バサラ$$
「$$シビル$$ is here! Let's do that one for the first time in ages!」

231:t_019:2.en:
$$バサラ$$
「Here we go! Listen to my soooooong!!」

231:t_021:2.en:
$$オズマ$$
「Did you hear that, $$ゲペなんとか$$?! That's $$バサラ$$'s soooooong!!」

231:t_021:3.en:
$$アルト$$
「Why are you the one bragging about it, Captain?!!」

231:t_021:4.en:
$$ゲペルニッチ$$
「Oh...! Ooh!! $$スピリチア$$!!」

231:t_021:5.en:
$$ゲペルニッチ$$
「It's coming... It's coming!!」

231:t_021:6.en:
$$オズマ$$
「That's right! Come on... Come on!!」

231:t_021:7.en:
$$ガビル$$
「It wells up from the depths of my body! This is life-beauty!!」

231:t_022:0.en:
$$ゲペルニッチ$$
「$$熱気バサラ$$... You and your friends may be able to overcome the true end that comes every 120 million years...」

231:t_022:2.en:
$$ゲペルニッチ$$
「We shall help you, too. Leave those enemies to us.」

231:t_022:3.en:
$$ガビル$$
「We shall meet again, $$ガムリン$$! Promise-beauty!」

231:t_023:1.en:
$$レイ#pt231$$
「Captain $$ガムリン$$, dealing with the enemy in front of us comes first.」

231:t_023:3.en:
$$バサラ$$
「Yeah! My heart's always burning bright!!」

231:t_023:4.en:
$$キャシー$$
「$$ゲペルニッチ$$ also knows the universe is in danger of collapse... The true collapse that comes every 120 million years...」

231:t_023:5.en:
$$モニカ$$
「Captain! The $$プロトデビルン$$ ship is also fighting $$サイデリアル$$ in the surrounding area!」

231:t_023:6.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「If we can secure their cooperation, we'll have hope! We must win this battle, whatever it takes!」

231:t_023:7.en:
$$バサラ$$
「Here we go, you guys! Listen to my sooooooong!!」

231:t_024:0.en:
$$モニカ$$
「All $$サイデリアル$$ and $$バジュラ$$ units are confirmed destroyed or withdrawn.」

231:t_024:1.en:
$$ラム$$
「Both the $$プロトデビルン$$ ship and the $$バトル７$$ are intact. Both report they will join us.」

231:t_024:2.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Incredible...! $$バサラ$$'s song is absolutely incredible!」

231:t_024:3.en:
$$ルカ$$
「His song saved us from being sent who knows where, and now it has made contact with the $$プロトデビルン$$...」

231:t_024:4.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「If $$ゲペルニッチ$$ can tell us the truth about the true end, it will be a great help.」

231:t_024:5.en:
$$カナリア$$
「The $$プロトデビルン$$ have lived for tens of thousands of years. The universe's collapse brought them here, too. They should have useful information.」

231:t_024:6.en:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「Hey, $$シビル$$... Do you know what the true collapse that comes every 120 million years means?」

231:t_024:7.en:
$$シビル$$
「$$シビル$$... like $$バサラ$$'s song!」

231:t_024:8.en:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「This isn't getting us anywhere...」

231:t_024:9.en:
$$レイ#pt231$$
「It's fine. We'll know everything soon.」

231:t_025:3.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Are those the bloodstained eyes?!」

231:t_026:1.en:
$$キャシー$$
「I've detected a distortion in the dimensional boundary! This... is a completely different pattern from anything we've observed before!」

231:t_026:2.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「All units, return to your ships! A $$時空震動$$ is coming!!」

231:t_026:4.en:
$$スズネ$$
(It's beginning... Or is it ending...?)

231:t_028:0.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「What is that thing...?! Its combat power is beyond anything the $$アンゲロイ$$ we've faced before can muster!」

231:t_028:1.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「It isn't just a variant...! It's something fundamentally different!」

231:t_028:2.en:
$$レド$$
「$$チェインバー#pilot$$! Search your database!」

231:t_028:3.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「The search is complete. There are no matching records.」

231:t_028:4.en:
$$レド$$
「So even the $$人類銀河同盟$$ has never encountered this type.」

231:t_028:5.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「An important consideration: another possibility is that every unit that encountered it was wiped out.」

231:t_028:7.en:
$$アルト$$
「No... We can't simply dismiss $$チェインバー#pilot$$'s theory as wrong...」

231:t_028:8.en:
$$シン$$
「Seeing its strength firsthand, I can believe it...」

231:t_028:9.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Can we... can Earth defeat something like this...?」

231:t_029:0.en:
$$ハサウェイ$$
「W-We managed to win, but...」

231:t_029:1.en:
$$カツ$$
「If they mass-produce things like this...」

231:t_029:3.en:
$n
(That machine means something more than that... That's what terrifies me...)

231:t_100:0.en:
$$アルト$$
($$ＹＦ－２９$$...! For now, I'll use your power to fight!)
